desc: I was created to be a warrior vessel. Many great warriors reside within me, ever dreaming of becoming a great champion.
location: Stormhill Gael Tunnel Redmane Castle Wailing Dunes Liurnia of the Lakes Mt. Gelmir Crumbling Farum Azula
whatItIs: Alexander is a warrior housed in a jar, first found wedged upside down in a crater south-west of Saintsbridge in Stormhill, and he can later be summoned as a co-operator.
whyItMatters: He calls himself a vessel holding many great warriors who dream of becoming champions, and freeing him opens a path that eventually pays out the Warrior Jar Shard, Alexander's Innards, and other gear tied to his journey.
whenToUse: Stand behind him and strike him until he pops loose for an Exalted Flesh, then look for him again later on, including behind a shutter in Gael Tunnel, and keep talking each time he appears.
name: Alexander, Warrior Jar
aka: Iron Fist Alexander (鉄拳のアレキサンダー, Tekken no Arekisandā)

locations.name: Stormhill Gael Tunnel Redmane Castle Wailing Dunes Liurnia of the Lakes Mt. Gelmir Crumbling Farum Azula

whatItIs: The Ancient Dragon-Man is a character with no further detail recorded in this database.
whyItMatters: Nothing beyond the name is tracked here, so no reason to seek him out can be given yet.
whenToUse: No action is needed based on what is currently known about him.
name: Ancient Dragon-Man

desc: Ahh, dear sister, you're finally here. No time to waste. Let's see the stars.
whatItIs: Aureliette is found at the Stargazers' Ruins in the Mountaintops of the Giants.
whyItMatters: She greets the player warmly as a sister and speaks of wanting to see the stars together.
whenToUse: Visit her at the ruins and talk with her to hear what she has to say about the stars.
name: Aureliette

desc: Never met someone with a taste for prawn I couldn't trust. We'd make good mates, I reckon.
whatItIs: Blackguard Big Boggart is a merchant in Liurnia of the Lakes, a huge man wearing an iron mask who trades from the Boilprawn Shack.
whyItMatters: He is friendly toward anyone who shares his taste for prawn, and he happens to be holding Rya the Scout's stolen necklace, so his shop connects into her story.
whenToUse: Speak with Rya at her gazebo on the southern lakeshore before entering Volcano Manor, then follow the shore north-west to Boggart at the Boilprawn Shack to buy or recover the necklace, along with items like Boiled Prawn and his Bell Bearing.
name: Blackguard Big Boggart

desc: Let's give them a show to remember, eh. Just don't you go dying on me. For Ranni's sake too.
whatItIs: Blaidd the Half-Wolf is an NPC met at Mistwood Ruins in Limgrave, a warrior who fights alongside the player and speaks of serving Ranni.
whyItMatters: His questline leads to gear including the Royal Greatsword, a full set of his armor, and the Black Wolf Mask, plus it marks the entrance to Nokron on the map.
whenToUse: Follow the howling into Mistwood east of Agheel Lake to meet him, then ask Kale at the Church of Elleh about the howling to learn the Finger Snap gesture that keeps his story moving.
name: Blaidd the Half-Wolf

desc: I am Yura, hunter of Bloody Fingers.
whatItIs: Bloody Finger Hunter Yura is an NPC resting under a ruined arch near the Seaside Ruins in Limgrave, a hunter who tracks down Bloody Fingers.
whyItMatters: Summoning him to help kill Flying Dragon Agheel and following his questline through to completion yields the katana Nagakiba, Eleonora's Poleblade, and a Purifying Crystal Tear.
whenToUse: Exhaust his dialogue near the Seaside Ruins so his summon sign appears by Agheel Lake, then call him in for the dragon fight and speak to him again afterward to hear what he says about Dragon Communion.
name: Bloody Finger Hunter Yura

desc: I, Boc the seamster, am forever in your service. May the throne of Elden Lord be yours.
whatItIs: Boc the Seamster, a demi-human, is found disguised as a small tree along the road south-east of the Agheel Lake North grace in Limgrave.
whyItMatters: Once freed from the tree's spell, he offers free armor alterations for the rest of the run, later including alterations to demigod garments after the Gold Sewing Needle.
whenToUse: Hit or roll into the tree to break the disguise and talk with him, then keep talking until he asks to sneak back into the cave his tribe cast him out of, and talk once more so he works up the nerve to go.
name: Boc the Seamster
aka: Boc the Seamster (お針子のボック)

desc: I teach incantations, the strength granted us by the Two Fingers, and explore the secrets of the Golden Order.
whatItIs: Brother Corhyn is a merchant in the central chamber of Roundtable Hold who teaches incantations tied to the Two Fingers and the Golden Order.
whyItMatters: His stock grows every time a prayerbook is handed over, and his story connects to Goldmask's, eventually offering the Mending Rune of Perfect Order and gear like the Radiant Gold Mask.
whenToUse: Bring him any prayerbook found while exploring to expand his sorcery-and-incantation shop, then talk to him again after reaching the Altus Plateau to hear that he is leaving to search for Goldmask.
name: Brother Corhyn

desc: I'm Edgar, warden of this castle as ordained by Lord Godrick himself.
location: Castle Morne (originally) South along the road from the Bridge of Sacrifice
whatItIs: Castellan Edgar, styled Edgar the Revenger, is the warden of Castle Morne, appointed by Lord Godrick himself.
whyItMatters: He can appear as either a co-operator or an invader across the Weeping Peninsula and Limgrave.
whenToUse: Watch for him around Castle Morne and the road south of the Bridge of Sacrifice, ready for either an ally or a fight.
name: Castellan Edgar

locations.name: Castle Morne (originally) South along the road from the Bridge of Sacrifice

desc: I am Jerren. Foolish old warrior, and witness.
whatItIs: Castellan Jerren, also known as Witch-Hunter Jerren, is a co-operator found at Redmane Castle in Caelid.
whyItMatters: He calls himself a foolish old warrior and a witness, hinting at a past tied to witch-hunting.
whenToUse: Find his summon sign at Redmane Castle if an extra ally is wanted for that fight.
name: Castellan Jerren

desc: The stars are dark tonight. But rest assured, this is no ill omen. On the contrary. I believe that this portends a magnificent starry cascade.
whatItIs: Count Ymir, High Priest, is a merchant and boss found on a throne inside the Cathedral of Manus Metyr, also called the Mother of Fingers.
whyItMatters: His questline with Jolan pays out a long list of gear, including seed talismans, the Maternal Staff, a full High Priest garment set, and the Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers.
whenToUse: Reach the cathedral by dropping down the side track off the Church District Highroad, then talk to Ymir and exhaust every dialogue option, including the line about glintstone sorcery, to receive a hollowed stone necklace and a ruins map.
name: Count Ymir, High Priest

whatItIs: D, Beholder of Death, also known as Devin, is a co-operator found in the Siofra Aqueduct area of Nokron, Eternal City.
whyItMatters: Beyond his location and his role as a summonable ally, no other detail is recorded for him.
whenToUse: Look for his summon sign in the Siofra Aqueduct if extra help is wanted there.
name: D, Beholder of Death

location: West of Summonwater Village (initially) Roundtable Hold
whatItIs: D, Hunter of the Dead, also called Darian, is a merchant and co-operator first found on the road near Saintsbridge in Limgrave, later moving to Roundtable Hold.
whyItMatters: His questline with his twin pays out the Litany of Proper Death incantation, Order's Blade, the Twinned Armor set, and the Inseparable Sword.
whenToUse: Hear him out on the road near Saintsbridge, then clear Summonwater Village and defeat the Tibia Mariner holding the first Deathroot so he can offer to introduce the beast that eats it.
name: D, Hunter of the Dead

locations.name: West of Summonwater Village (initially) Roundtable Hold

desc: Long ago, Florissax assumed human form to share Dragon Communion with the world.
whatItIs: The Dragon Communion Priestess, also called Florissax, presides at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion.
whyItMatters: She is described as having taken human form long ago specifically to share Dragon Communion with the world.
whenToUse: Visit the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion to interact with her directly.
name: Dragon Communion Priestess

desc: Bayle! Vile Bayle! O terror incarnate! There is life in me yet! I will soon feast upon your heart! Mark my words! You too shall know fear!
whatItIs: Igon, called the Drake Warrior, is found wedged in the rocks below a pillar-road waypoint on Jagged Peak, screaming about the dragon Bayle.
whyItMatters: His questline pays out Igon's Greatbow, its matching Ash of War, and a full set of Igon's armor, along with the Heart of Bayle.
whenToUse: Rest at the waypoint and follow the screaming down the slope to find him, then talk to him even though he is too consumed by his own pain to hold a real conversation, since the meeting has to happen before the rest of his story continues.
name: Drake Warrior Igon

whatItIs: Dryleaf Dane is an NPC tied to the Highroad Cross area of Scadu Altus, reachable after entering that region.
whyItMatters: His questline teaches the Dryleaf Arts fighting style and rewards Dane's Hat, Dane's Footwork, and a full Dryleaf garment set.
whenToUse: Reach Highroad Cross in Scadu Altus and pick up the May the Best Win gesture and the Monk's Missive from the broken wall beside the grace, which points toward seeking him out and challenging him without words.
name: Dryleaf Dane

desc: I am the Dung Eater! A scourge upon the living!
whatItIs: The Dung Eater, styled the Loathsome Dung Eater, is an invader NPC whose apparition sits in Roundtable Hold past Gideon's study, tied to Leyndell, Royal Capital.
whyItMatters: His questline, the seedbed curse, pays out the Sewer-Gaol Key, the Sword of Milos, and the full Omen armor set.
whenToUse: Touch any grace on the Altus Plateau to make his apparition appear at the hub, then find a curse before he takes interest in speaking with you further.
name: Dung Eater

desc: It is said that the bones belong to an ancient lord - the soulless king. The lord of the lost and desperate, who was known as Ensha.
whatItIs: Ensha of the Royal Remains is an invader said to be the bones of an ancient, soulless king, found leaning against a wall outside Gideon's study in Roundtable Hold.
whyItMatters: Talking to him teaches the 'What Do You Want?' gesture, and defeating him during his ambush yields Clinging Bone and the full Royal Remains armor set.
whenToUse: Talk to him outside Gideon's study before his invasion of Roundtable Hold plays out, since the gesture is gone for good once he is dead.
name: Ensha of the Royal Remains

desc: Greetings, great champion called by grace. I am Fia.
whatItIs: Fia, the Deathbed Companion, is found lying in a bedroom in the eastern wing of Roundtable Hold, greeting the player as a champion called by grace.
whyItMatters: Accepting her embrace grants Baldachin's Blessing, though her keepsake shaves five percent off maximum HP while it is held, and her later questline yields the Knifeprint Clue and the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince.
whenToUse: Accept her embrace when first found, then once Sorcerer Rogier has moved into the Hold and mentioned the Night of Black Knives, ask her about knifeprints to continue her story.
name: Fia, Deathbed Companion

whatItIs: Finger Maiden Therolina is a Finger Maiden located somewhere within Caelid.
whyItMatters: Her title places her among the Finger Maidens, though nothing further is on record about her.
whenToUse: Seek her out in Caelid to see what she offers; nothing more specific is tracked.
name: Finger Maiden Therolina

desc: You, please, I can read them. Your fingers, please, your fingers...
whatItIs: Finger Reader Crone is found somewhere in Limgrave, asking to read the player's fingers.
whyItMatters: Her single recorded line points to finger-reading as her purpose, without further context attached.
whenToUse: Approach her in Limgrave and offer your fingers if that dialogue option appears.
name: Finger Reader Crone

desc: Are you that new Tarnished? You've done well. I am Enia, the Finger Reader. I interpret the words of the Fingers, envoys to the Greater Will.
whatItIs: Finger Reader Enia is a merchant found in Roundtable Hold who interprets the words of the Fingers, envoys to the Greater Will.
whyItMatters: She greets new Tarnished directly, identifying her purpose as reading and interpreting messages from the Fingers.
whenToUse: Speak with her in Roundtable Hold to hear those interpretations as the story unfolds.
name: Finger Reader Enia

desc: Queen Marika, behold! I have excised another. Another cancer to thy joy.
location: Belurat, Tower Settlement Church of the Crusade Shadow Keep
whatItIs: Fire Knight Queelign is a Fire Knight loyal to Messmer the Impaler and Queen Marika, who ambushes the player first in Belurat, Tower Settlement and again near the Church of the Crusade.
whyItMatters: Defeating him across both ambushes yields the Crusade Insignia, the Ash of War: Flame Skewer, his own Greatsword, and the Prayer Room Key.
whenToUse: Fight him when he invades the graveyard plaza north of the small altar grace in Belurat, then again at the blackened church beneath the beheaded statue of Marika on the western plateau.
name: Fire Knight Queelign (NPC)

locations.name: Belurat, Tower Settlement Church of the Crusade Shadow Keep

desc: Should you spot any forager brood, be sure to mind your manners.
whatItIs: Forager Brood describes figures encountered within the Realm of Shadow.
whyItMatters: The only guidance recorded about them concerns manners rather than combat or trade.
whenToUse: Be sure to mind your manners around them if one is spotted in the Realm of Shadow.
name: Forager Brood

desc: Now, I suppose I'm free. I can do whatever takes my fancy... Can't I, mate?
whatItIs: Gatekeeper Gostoc is a merchant stationed at the gatehouse by Stormveil Castle's main entrance in Limgrave.
whyItMatters: How the encounter with him plays out affects whether a Grace Mimic appears, whether a merchant opens up inside Stormveil, and whether an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone goes on sale for 20,000 runes.
whenToUse: Choose between his offered front door and side path at the main gate, and later, if he traps you in a dark room in the western castle with a Banished Knight, grab the Rusty Key to get out.
name: Gatekeeper Gostoc

desc: "Do you know of the Noble Goldmask? Though he was but a Tarnished, living outside the Lands Between, he was a great scholar, who foresaw the coming guidance of Grace."
whatItIs: Goldmask, styled the Noble Goldmask or Ever-Brilliant Goldmask, is found on the Altus Plateau.
whyItMatters: He is described as a Tarnished scholar from outside the Lands Between who foresaw the coming guidance of Grace.
whenToUse: Seek him out on the Altus Plateau to hear more about his reputation as a scholar.
name: Goldmask

whatItIs: Great Jar is found in Caelid, within the area known as Greyoll's Dragonbarrow.
whyItMatters: No dialogue beyond silence is recorded for this figure, leaving little else to note.
whenToUse: Visit the Dragonbarrow location if this particular jar is worth seeing in person.
name: Great Jar

desc: Death... My sin... Should not be touched...by the hand of man...
whatItIs: Gurranq, Beast Clergyman, is found at the Bestial Sanctum within Caelid's Greyoll's Dragonbarrow area.
whyItMatters: His words dwell on death and sin, suggesting private guilt without any further explanation on record.
whenToUse: Head to the Bestial Sanctum to hear what he has to say for himself.
name: Gurranq, Beast Clergyman

whatItIs: Hornsent is a warrior serving Miquella's Followers, found beside Freyja at Three-Path Cross on Gravesite Plain.
whyItMatters: His questline unlocks the Cross Map marking Miquella's crosses and, if a Scorpion Stew is brought to him, tells a story about what Messmer's crusade did to his people, along with the Falx and a full Braided garment set becoming available.
whenToUse: Talk to him at Three-Path Cross and exhaust his dialogue for the Cross Map, then bring him a Scorpion Stew before the Sealing Tree at the Church of the Bud burns, since he stops being reachable outside combat after that.
name: Hornsent (character)

desc: O Sculpted keeper, channel thy choler, into the most resplendent of dances. My song will I sing...in service to thee.
whatItIs: Hornsent Grandam is a spirit-caller tied to the Sculpted Keepers and the Divine Beast Enir-Ilim, found in a storeroom within Belurat, Tower Settlement.
whyItMatters: Reaching her rewards the Watchful Spirit ashes and the Divine Beast Head, and she is the source of the Scorpion Stew and Gourmet Scorpion Stew used elsewhere.
whenToUse: From the small altar grace in Belurat, head north-west past the omen knight and follow the drainage channel through the storeroom key puzzle to reach her.
name: Hornsent Grandam

desc: My name is Irina. I've escaped from Castle Morne, to the south. The servants there... have rebelled.
location: Weeping Peninsula, south of Bridge of Sacrifice
whatItIs: Irina of Morne is a Finger Maiden sitting beside the road near the Bridge of Sacrifice in the Weeping Peninsula, having fled a rebellion at Castle Morne.
whyItMatters: Delivering her letter and reaching Castellan Edgar at Castle Morne yields the Sacrificial Twig and, further on, the Grafted Blade Greatsword and Banished Knight's Halberd.
whenToUse: Talk to her twice to accept the letter, then carry it to Castellan Edgar at Castle Morne; once his dialogue is exhausted after the castle's boss falls, she dies, so finish anything you want from her before that.
name: Irina of Morne

locations.name: Weeping Peninsula, south of Bridge of Sacrifice

desc: One day, I'll be just like Uncle Alexander. And I'll have to leave the village to become a champion.
whatItIs: Jar-Bairn is a small jar-child found sitting in front of a house in Jarburg, Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: He speaks of wanting to become a champion like his Uncle Alexander, and talking with him through the village eventually yields the Companion Jar.
whenToUse: Talk to him where he sits, then rest at the village grace and speak with him again for more dialogue, including his invitation to pick the rare flowers growing between the houses.
name: Jar-Bairn

desc: I am Jolán. The Night is yours now to wield.
whatItIs: Jolan, Swordhand of Night, is tied to Count Ymir and the Age of the Stars, found at the Cathedral of Manus Metyr.
whyItMatters: He tells the player that the night is now theirs to wield, framing his role within that story thread.
whenToUse: Meet him at the Cathedral of Manus Metyr as part of exploring that storyline.
name: Jolán, Swordhand of Night
affiliation: Count Ymir Age of the Stars

location: Ruined structure east of Artist's Shack (Limgrave)
whatItIs: Kenneth Haight, called the Limgrave Heir, stands atop a ruined structure east of the Artist's Shack in Limgrave.
whyItMatters: Agreeing to retake his fort and defeating the Godrick Knight holding it rewards the Erdsteel Dagger and leaves Fort Haight cleared and reoccupied.
whenToUse: Talk to him at the ruined structure and agree to help, then fight through Fort Haight to the top of the keep to finish the job.
name: Kenneth Haight

locations.name: Ruined structure east of Artist's Shack (Limgrave)

desc: O Greater Will, hear my voice. I am the recusant Bernahl, inheritor of my brother's will, and you will fall to my blade.
location: Warmaster's Shack Volcano Manor Fortified Manor Crumbling Farum Azula
whatItIs: Knight Bernahl, also called Recusant Bernahl, is first found at the Warmaster's Shack north of Gatefront Ruins in Limgrave, later relocating to Volcano Manor.
whyItMatters: His questline rewards the Raging Wolf armor set, the Ash of War: Eruption, and the Ash of War: Assassin's Gambit, plus the Blasphemous Claw and Gelmir's Fury.
whenToUse: Speak to him at the Warmaster's Shack to open his ashes of war shop, then join Volcano Manor through Tanith so he relocates there; defeating Rykard early instead skips his questline and moves his drops back to the shack.
name: Knight Bernahl

locations.name: Warmaster's Shack Volcano Manor Fortified Manor Crumbling Farum Azula

location: Roundtable Hold Academy Gate Town Volcano Manor Jarburg
whatItIs: Knight Diallos is first met in Roundtable Hold and later found near the Academy Gate Town grace in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: His questline over the loss of his servant Lanya pays out Hoslow's Petal Whip and Diallos's Mask.
whenToUse: Talk to him in Roundtable Hold about his missing servant Lanya, then find him again near Academy Gate Town after he learns of her death and exhaust everything he says.
name: Knight Diallos

locations.name: Roundtable Hold Academy Gate Town Volcano Manor Jarburg

desc: I'm Latenna. An Albinauric, the same as Old Albus. My apologies for my coarse words earlier. I presumed the worst, seeing that you were another Tarnished, like that all-hearing brute.
whatItIs: Latenna the Albinauric is a wolfback archer found at the Slumbering Wolf's Shack in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: Her questline, worked through Old Albus and the Village of the Albinaurics, rewards her own summonable spirit ash and a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
whenToUse: Find Old Albus disguised as a pot at the bottom of the Village of the Albinaurics for the Haligtree Secret Medallion, then clear the Lakeside Crystal Cave to reach the ledge tied to her story.
name: Latenna the Albinauric

desc: My eyesight has been weak since birth, you see. I can't tell which way I'm supposed to go next. But when I eat one of those grapes, I can feel a distant light in the back of my eyes.
whatItIs: Lightseeker Hyetta, also called Finger Maiden Hyetta, is a blind Finger Maiden who appears near the Lake-Facing Cliffs grace in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: Her questline rewards the Frenzied Flame Seal and Frenzyflame Stone, and it ties into the Lord of Frenzied Flame ending.
whenToUse: Let Irina of Morne's own questline run its course to its natural end first, since Hyetta will not appear while Irina is alive, then speak with her near the Lake-Facing Cliffs and bring her a Shabriri Grape.
name: Lightseeker Hyetta
aka: Finger Maiden Hyetta (巫女ハイータ, Miko Haīta)

desc: I can play the role of maiden. Turning runes into strength. To aid you in your search for the Elden Ring. You need only take me with you. To the foot of the Erdtree.
whatItIs: Melina, also called the Kindling Maiden, appears after lighting at least two Sites of Grace out in the open world of Limgrave and sitting at one.
whyItMatters: Accepting her accord is what allows runes to be spent on levels at all, and it unlocks the Spectral Steed Whistle that calls Torrent for the rest of the game.
whenToUse: Light two graces and rest at one to trigger her appearance, then accept the accord early since leveling up and calling Torrent both depend on it.
name: Melina

desc: You know, if you can spare the runes, you should buy yourself a crafting kit. A crafting kit allows you to make basic items on your own. Essential really, if you intend to survive out here for any duration.
whatItIs: Merchant Kale sits by the fire at the Church of Elleh in Limgrave and is usually the first trader a new Tarnished meets.
whyItMatters: He sells the Crafting Kit that unlocks the item-crafting menu, along with the Finger Snap gesture, a Telescope, and early cookbooks.
whenToUse: Buy the Crafting Kit from him as early as possible, since it is cheap at his shop but leaves his stock and costs more at the Twin Maiden Husks after the second shardbearer is defeated.
name: Merchant Kalé

desc: Tell whoever put you up to this. That if I am to flower into something other than myself, I would rather rot into nothingness as I am.
whatItIs: Millicent is an optional co-operator and invader found at the Church of the Plague in Caelid, and can also be fought as a red phantom in the Swamp of Aeonia.
whyItMatters: Her journey pays out the Prosthesis-Wearer Heirloom, the Rotten Winged Sword Insignia, Millicent's Prosthesis, and the Unalloyed Gold Needle needed to mend her snapped needle.
whenToUse: Summon her as a co-operator or fight her optional red phantom invasion in the Swamp of Aeonia, then take the snapped needle dropped by Commander O'Neil at the Heart of Aeonia to Sage Gowry to have it mended for her.
name: Millicent

desc: Heresy is not native to the world; it is but a contrivance. All things can be conjoined.
whatItIs: Miriel, Pastor of Vows, is a merchant stationed at the Church of Vows in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: His remark that all things can be conjoined reflects a belief that heresy is a human contrivance rather than something native to the world.
whenToUse: Stop by the Church of Vows to browse his wares whenever passing through that part of Liurnia.
name: Miriel, Pastor of Vows

desc: I like finding things. For you, Lady Leda, her allies, and the forager brood. Things bring joy to all.
whatItIs: Moore is a scavenger tied to Miquella's Followers and the Forager Brood, found sitting beside Ansbach at Main Gate Cross.
whyItMatters: Completing his questline yields the Verdigris armor set plus a shield, his Bell Bearing, and the Forager Brood Cookbook.
whenToUse: Speak with Moore at Main Gate Cross to unlock further dialogue, then introduce yourself to Thiollier at Pillar Path Cross before returning to talk with Moore and receive the Black Syrup, all before entering Shadow Keep.
name: Moore
affiliation: Miquella's Followers Forager Brood Servants of Rot (formerly)

location: Mohgwyn Palace (Cocoon of the Empyrean Site of Grace) Gravesite Plain (Three-Path Cross Site of Grace) Enir-Ilim (Cleansing Chamber Anteroom)
whatItIs: Needle Knight Leda is found standing before the cocoon at the Cocoon of the Empyrean in Mohgwyn Palace, tied to Miquella and his followers.
whyItMatters: Her questline rewards Leda's Sword, Leda's Armor, the Oathseeker Knight set pieces, and both Crossed-Tree talismans.
whenToUse: Defeat Starscourge Radahn and Mohg, Lord of Blood, then rest at the grace in Mohg's arena so Leda appears, and touch the withered arm inside the cocoon to be carried into the Land of Shadow.
name: Needle Knight Leda

locations.name: Mohgwyn Palace (Cocoon of the Empyrean Site of Grace) Gravesite Plain (Three-Path Cross Site of Grace) Enir-Ilim (Cleansing Chamber Anteroom)

desc: Let the scars I carve remind them. I am Nepheli Loux. Warrior.
location: Stormveil Castle Roundtable Hold Village of the Albinaurics
whatItIs: Nepheli Loux is a co-operator NPC met inside Stormveil Castle, later found in Roundtable Hold and the Village of the Albinaurics.
whyItMatters: Her questline rewards the Arsenal Charm and depends on Roderika's own progress with Smithing Master Hewg to reach its conclusion.
whenToUse: Push Roderika's questline forward until she is working as a spirit tuner opposite Hewg, then talk to Sir Gideon Ofnir and exhaust his dialogue so he retreats into his study.
name: Nepheli Loux, Warrior

locations.name: Stormveil Castle Roundtable Hold Village of the Albinaurics

whatItIs: Nomadic Merchants are traders scattered across Limgrave, starting with Merchant Kale at the Church of Elleh.
whyItMatters: Trading with the full circuit of them collects a wide range of bell bearings, including Kale's own and multiple numbered Nomadic Merchant's Bell Bearings.
whenToUse: Start with Kale at the Church of Elleh, then sweep the three open-world camps in Limgrave: near Agheel Lake's shore, on the road toward Mistwood, and up by Saintsbridge.
name: Nomadic Merchants

desc: I am Albus. An Albinauric, as you can see. We're finished. The whole village is finished.
location: Village of the Albinaurics, Liurnia of the Lakes
whatItIs: Old Albus, also called Albus the Albinauric, resides in the Village of the Albinaurics in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: He speaks plainly of his people and his village as finished, giving a bleak picture of their fate.
whenToUse: Visit the village to hear him out; his entry carries no further guidance beyond that.
name: Old Albus

locations.name: Village of the Albinaurics, Liurnia of the Lakes

desc: Well, well, well? Thought you'd just help yourself to a man's personal belongings? You scheming little thief. The gods demand repentance! Cough up your coin, all of it!
whatItIs: Patches is found dropping from the ceiling of the boss room in Murkwater Cave, Limgrave, accusing the player of theft.
whyItMatters: Fighting him down to about half health ends the confrontation and turns him into a travelling companion who later offers gestures like Grovel For Mercy and Calm Down!, plus the Magma Whip Candlestick.
whenToUse: Open the treasure chest in the Murkwater Cave boss room to trigger his ambush, fight him to roughly half health, then reload the area so he switches from fighting to trading.
name: Patches

whatItIs: Phillia, Towering Little Sister, is located at the Apostate Derelict in the Consecrated Snowfield.
whyItMatters: Only her title and location are on record, leaving her significance unclear for now.
whenToUse: Head to the Apostate Derelict to find her if that area is being explored anyway.
name: Phillia, Towering Little Sister

desc: Y-you're my puppets! I loved you with all I have!
whatItIs: Pidia, Carian Servant, is a merchant stationed at Caria Manor in Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: His line about loving his puppets hints at a strange devotion to the manor's occupants.
whenToUse: Trade with him at Caria Manor while passing through that part of the manor grounds.
name: Pidia, Carian Servant

whatItIs: Primeval Sorcerer Azur is located on Mt. Gelmir, within the wider Altus Plateau region.
whyItMatters: Nothing beyond his location is currently on record to explain his significance.
whenToUse: Travel to Mt. Gelmir to find him if that region is being explored.
name: Primeval Sorcerer Azur

whatItIs: Primeval Sorcerer Lusat is located at the Sellia Hideaway within Caelid.
whyItMatters: As with Azur, only his hideaway location is tracked, without further detail on record.
whenToUse: Travel to the Sellia Hideaway to find him if that part of Caelid is being explored.
name: Primeval Sorcerer Lusat

desc: Jolán and Anna were born in a cold, dark gaol, where they were raised, deprived of light, to be Swordhands of Night.
location: Rabbath's Rise Finger Ruins of Miyr
whatItIs: The Puppet of Anna, called Swordhand of Night Anna, is tied to Count Ymir and found at Rabbath's Rise and the Finger Ruins of Miyr.
whyItMatters: She and Jolan are described as raised in a cold, dark gaol specifically to become Swordhands of Night.
whenToUse: Visit Rabbath's Rise or the Finger Ruins of Miyr to encounter her as part of that story.
name: Puppet of Anna

locations.name: Rabbath's Rise Finger Ruins of Miyr

desc: I am the witch Ranni. I stole Death long ago, and search now for the dark path. That I might one day upend the whole of it, and rid the world of all that came before.
whatItIs: Ranni the Witch, also known as Renna, Lady Ranni, or the Lunar Princess, is tied to the Carian Royal Family and can first be met at the Church of Elleh in Limgrave.
whyItMatters: Her questline leads to the Spirit Calling Bell and Lone Wolf Ashes needed to summon spirits, and eventually to the Dark Moon Ring, the Dark Moon Greatsword, and the Age of the Stars ending.
whenToUse: After receiving the Spectral Steed Whistle from Melina, ride Torrent and rest at a grace before returning to speak with 'Renna' at the Church of Elleh, or buy the same Spirit Calling Bell and Lone Wolf Ashes from the Twin Maiden Husks if that meeting is missed.
name: Ranni the Witch
aka: Lunar Princess Ranni Lady Ranni Renna
affiliation: Carian Royal Family Black Knife Assassins (formerly) Two Fingers (formerly)

whatItIs: Redmane Freyja is a former member of the Redmane Knights, tied to Three-Path Cross on Gravesite Plain.
whyItMatters: Her questline rewards the Golden Lion Shield, Freyja's Greatsword, and a full set of Freyja's armor, and she can be summoned as a strong ally for the Divine Beast Dancing Lion fight.
whenToUse: Speak to her at Three-Path Cross and exhaust her dialogue before entering Shadow Keep, then look for her gold summon sign at the Stagefront grace in Belurat for that boss fight.
name: Redmane Freyja

desc: Foul trespasser. Send word far and wide. Of the last Queen of Caria, Rennala of the Full Moon. And the majesty of the night she conjureth.
wiki: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
whatItIs: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, is tied to the Carian Royal Family and found at the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
whyItMatters: She addresses the player as a trespasser and speaks proudly of her past as the last Queen of Caria.
whenToUse: Face her at the Academy of Raya Lucaria as part of progressing through that stronghold.
name: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
displayName: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
aka: Full Moon Witch Lunar Queen Queen of Caria
affiliation: Carian Royal Family Academy of Raya Lucaria

desc: Roderika the spirit tuner prentice. Pleased to make your acquaintance.
whatItIs: Roderika, called the Heartbroken Maiden, is a spirit tuner prentice found inside Stormhill Shack, later relocating to Roundtable Hold.
whyItMatters: Talking with her yields the Spirit Jellyfish Ashes, the first real summon spirit, the Sitting Sideways gesture, and eventually spirit ash upgrades at Roundtable Hold.
whenToUse: Exhaust her dialogue at Stormhill Shack before defeating Godrick the Grafted, since the Sitting Sideways gesture can never be obtained once she has relocated to Roundtable Hold.
name: Roderika, Spirit Tuner
aka: Heartbroken Maiden (心折れた娘, Kokoro-Oreta Musume)

desc: I am Rya, in the service of Lady Tanith of the Volcano Manor
whatItIs: Rya the Scout, whose birth name is Zorayas, serves Lady Tanith of Volcano Manor and is first found in a small folly north of the Laskyar Ruins in Liurnia.
whyItMatters: Recovering her stolen necklace from Blackguard Big Boggart opens her questline toward the Volcano Manor Invitation, Daedicar's Woe, and Zorayas's Letter.
whenToUse: Exhaust her dialogue at the folly, then either buy Rya's Necklace from Boggart at the Boilprawn Shack for 1,000 runes or take it from his corpse, though killing him ends his own story.
name: Rya the Scout

desc: Oh, a pleasure to see you, a pleasure indeed. I am Gowry. A great sage, in my day, anyway.
whatItIs: Sage Gowry, going by Gowry, is a sage of the Servants of Rot found at Gowry's Shack near the Sellia Gateway in Caelid.
whyItMatters: Accepting his bargain explains how the sealed town of Sellia is opened, and his questline rewards Sellia's Secret, Pest Threads, and the Flock's Canvas Talisman.
whenToUse: Hear him out at his shack and accept the bargain, then cross the scarlet swamp to the Heart of Aeonia and defeat Commander O'Neil for the broken needle his story depends on.
name: Sage Gowry

desc: I am Seluvis, preceptor in the sorcerous arts. I don't know what it is the mistress sees in a provincial Tarnished like you...
whatItIs: Preceptor Seluvis is a merchant who teaches the sorcerous arts, found at Seluvis's Rise in the Three Sisters area of Liurnia of the Lakes.
whyItMatters: His scheme rewards the Magic Scorpion Charm, his own Bell Bearing, the Preceptor's Set, and a collection of Puppet items.
whenToUse: Enter Ranni's service and speak with the projections around her tower before returning to Seluvis, then agree to his errand even though the potion he gives is not what it claims to be.
name: Seluvis

desc: Ahhh, may chaos take the world! May chaos take the world!
whatItIs: Shabriri, called the Most Reviled Man in All History, is a blindfolded swordsman found at the Zamor Ruins in the Mountaintops of the Giants.
whyItMatters: He is revealed to be wearing the body of Bloody Finger Hunter Yura, marking the end of Yura's own story, and his path rewards the Iron Kasa and the Ronin armor set.
whenToUse: Look at him closely before talking, then follow his path toward the Frenzied Flame if the Lord of Frenzied Flame ending is the goal.
name: Shabriri
aka: The Most Reviled Man in All History

whatItIs: Sir Ansbach is a co-operator formerly of the Mohgwyn Dynasty and Pureblood Knights, now among Miquella's Followers, found beside Main Gate Cross.
whyItMatters: Telling him about Miquella's crosses across Gravesite Plain and the Cerulean Coast rewards the Furious Blade of Ansbach, a full Ansbach's garment set, and the Letter for Freyja.
whenToUse: Talk to him at Main Gate Cross and report back on any of Miquella's crosses found, including the one on the Cerulean Coast cliff, which reveals where Miquella shed St. Trina.
name: Sir Ansbach
affiliation: Miquella's Followers Mohgwyn Dynasty (formerly) Pureblood Knights (formerly)

desc: As a Tarnished who wishes to stand before the Elden Ring and become Elden Lord, I am accumulating knowledge. To be all-knowing.
whatItIs: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing, is found in the central chamber of Roundtable Hold, seeking knowledge on his own path to becoming Elden Lord.
whyItMatters: Once welcomed as a full member of his circle he shares intel on major shardbearers and rewards a full All-Knowing armor set, the Scepter of the All-Knowing, and the Law of Causality sorcery.
whenToUse: Exhaust his dialogue on the first visit to the Hold, then defeat any shardbearer and speak with Finger Reader Enia before returning to him to unlock his fuller conversation and rewards.
name: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing

desc: I'm trapped by the Hold, undying, smithing for you fools. That's all there is to it.
whatItIs: Smithing Master Hewg is a blacksmith found in Roundtable Hold, describing himself as trapped there, undying, and forced to smith.
whyItMatters: He is the one who upgrades weapons at the Hold, a service tied directly to his role as blacksmith.
whenToUse: Visit him in Roundtable Hold whenever weapons need upgrading with smithing stones.
name: Smithing Master Hewg

whatItIs: Sorcerer Rogier is a merchant first found kneeling in a chapel inside Stormveil Castle, later relocating to Roundtable Hold.
whyItMatters: His questline rewards Rogier's Rapier, his Bell Bearing, and three combat Ashes of War, including Carian Greatsword and Spinning Weapon.
whenToUse: Talk to him in the Stormveil chapel and exhaust his dialogue before finding his bloodstain deeper in the castle, since finding that bloodstain too early makes him disappear from Stormveil for good.
name: Sorcerer Rogier

desc: Tarnished, are we? A wonder you should turn up here. I am Sellen, a sorcerer, quite plainly.
whatItIs: Sorceress Sellen, called the Graven Witch, is a glintstone sorcerer expelled from the Academy of Raya Lucaria, found in the cellar of the Waypoint Ruins in Limgrave.
whyItMatters: Becoming her apprentice opens her shop and eventually rewards the powerful Comet Azur sorcery, Stars of Ruin, and the Witch's Glintstone Crown.
whenToUse: Clear the Waypoint Ruins cellar and choose to become her apprentice by asking to learn glintstone sorceries, and if carrying Seluvis's Introduction, speak with her again before the Radahn Festival ends for an extra conversation.
name: Sorceress Sellen
affiliation: Academy of Raya Lucaria (expelled) Castellan Jerren Preceptor Seluvis

desc: St. Trina is an enigmatic figure. Some say she is a comely young girl, others are sure he is a boy. The only certainty is that their appearance was as sudden as their disappearance.
whatItIs: St. Trina is described as an enigmatic figure of uncertain gender, tied to the Stone Coffin Fissure, whose appearance is said to be as sudden as their disappearance.
whyItMatters: The questline built around them, followed through Thiollier and Moore, rewards St. Trina's Smile and a full set of Thiollier's garments before Shadow Keep is entered.
whenToUse: Speak with Thiollier at his crossroads grace, then bring Moore's black syrup along before entering Shadow Keep, since doing so closes that errand and forfeits a spirit ash reward.
name: St. Trina

desc: Ohh great sun! Frigid sun of Sol! Surrender yourself to the eclipse! Grant life to the soulless bones!
whatItIs: Stranded Souls, referred to individually as a Stranded Soul, appear across the Lands Between, including within Limgrave.
whyItMatters: Their chant about the frigid sun of Sol and the eclipse points toward a ritual meant to grant life to soulless bones.
whenToUse: Listen for their chant while exploring Limgrave and the wider Lands Between.
name: Stranded Souls

desc: Rise with us, against the Erdtree.
whatItIs: Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress, greets visitors with a call to rise against the Erdtree, and is found just inside the manor's entrance.
whyItMatters: Joining her family through the Drawing-Room Key opens the path toward Lord Rykard and rewards like the Blasphemous Blade, Rykard's Rancor, and the Consort's garment set.
whenToUse: Reach Volcano Manor and speak to Tanith to join, taking the Drawing-Room Key, before defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, since that closes the whole questline.
name: Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress

desc: I am afraid I underestimated the lad. Appearing frail in both body and mind, I presumed he'd be like to stumble upon the field of battle... What a fool I was.
whatItIs: Thiollier, also called Sir Thiollier, is a merchant of Miquella's Followers tied to St. Trina, found sitting at Pillar Path Cross.
whyItMatters: Someone underestimated him for appearing frail, and his own words suggest he proved himself stronger than expected in battle; his questline rewards a full Thiollier garment set and St. Trina's Smile.
whenToUse: Exhaust his dialogue to open his shop, then buy from Moore at Main Gate Cross and mention Thiollier to receive Black Syrup to deliver, before entering Shadow Keep closes that option.
name: Thiollier

desc: My name is Thops. Presuming you're interested, I can teach you sorceries, as promised. Only, none of them are particularly great...
whatItIs: Thops, called Thops the Bluntstone, is a merchant found at the Church of Irith in Liurnia of the Lakes, along the cliff road out of Stormveil Castle.
whyItMatters: He teaches sorceries by his own admission that are not particularly great, and his questline rewards the Academy Glintstone Staff, the Gavel of Haima, and the Cannon of Haima.
whenToUse: Donate 10 runes to open his shop, then buy the sorceries he offers early, since he is the only sorcery instructor in the game whose stock cannot be expanded with scrolls.
name: Thops

whatItIs: Twin Maiden Husks are merchants stationed within Roundtable Hold.
whyItMatters: Their role as traders at the Hold is the only detail recorded for them here.
whenToUse: Check in with them at Roundtable Hold whenever passing through that hub.
name: Twin Maiden Husks

desc: Someone, please, kill him... That horrendous serpent... Praetor Rykard...
whatItIs: The Volcano Manor Apparition appears within Volcano Manor, in the Mt. Gelmir region.
whyItMatters: Its plea calls for someone to kill Praetor Rykard, described as a horrendous serpent.
whenToUse: Listen to what the apparition says while exploring Volcano Manor itself.
name: Volcano Manor Apparition

desc: I am Iji. The Carian royal family's dedicated blacksmith, and Lady Ranni's war counsellor.
location: Road to the Manor, Liurnia of the Lakes
whatItIs: War Counselor Iji serves as the Carian royal family's blacksmith and Lady Ranni's war counsellor, found on the Road to the Manor in Liurnia.
whyItMatters: Holding both a blacksmith and merchant role, he covers crafting and trading for the Carian royal family in one stop.
whenToUse: Visit him on the Road to the Manor for blacksmithing or trading whenever passing that way.
name: War Counselor Iji

locations.name: Road to the Manor, Liurnia of the Lakes

desc: Bless the Mohgwyn Dynasty, with love!
location: Limgrave Liurnia of the Lakes Mohgwyn Palace
whatItIs: White-Faced Varre, also called White Mask Varre, appears across Limgrave, Liurnia of the Lakes, and Mohgwyn Palace.
whyItMatters: His declaration blessing the Mohgwyn Dynasty ties him directly to that bloodline's cause.
whenToUse: Look for him first in Limgrave, since his record lists that region ahead of the others.
name: White-Faced Varré

locations.name: Limgrave Liurnia of the Lakes Mohgwyn Palace
